title: Can we get game category flairs? 🙏
author: badboygangaster
selftext:
Yo mods and everyone,

Right now every game gets thrown into the same feed, so if you're into a specific type of game you have to scroll through everything to find it. Can we add **game category flairs** so posts are tagged by what kind of game they are?

Something like:

* Action
* Puzzle
* RPG / Adventure
* Strategy / Sim
* Horror
* Other

That way you can filter for the stuff you actually play, and devs get their games in front of the people who'll enjoy them.

If you're for it, drop an upvote, and comment your game below so I can try it out. Thanks mods, appreciate all you do 🙌
